blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) ordered the filing of charges against two officials and five other personnel at the Correctional Institution for Women (CIW) over more than P6 million in missing funds and administrative irregularities. In a statement on Wednesday, BuCor Director General Gregorio Catapang Jr. approved the recommendation to initiate administrative proceedings against former superintendents Daisy Sevilla-Castillote and Marjorie Ann Sanidad. The former superintendents were allegedly involved in handling funds entrusted to them by persons deprived of liberty (PDLs). Castillote will face administrative proceedings for gross neglect of duty and grave misconduct for her tenure as CIW superintendent, according […]...
